title: Degeneracy maps of a simplicial set are injective
statement: Let $S$ be a simplicial set [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-set], with face maps $d^{n+1}_j=S(\delta^{n+1}_j):S_{n+1}\to S_n$ ($\delta^{n+1}_j:[n]\to[n+1]$ the increasing injection omitting $j$) and degeneracy maps $s^n_i=S(\sigma^n_i):S_n\to S_{n+1}$ ($\sigma^n_i:[n+1]\to[n]$ the order-preserving surjection repeating $i$). Then for every $n\geq0$ and $0\leq i\leq n$ one has $d^{n+1}_i\circ s^n_i=\mathrm{id}_{S_n}$; in particular $s^n_i:S_n\to S_{n+1}$ is injective.

source.place: Lemma 016F (lemma-si-injective) and its proof ('This is true because $d_i^{n+1}\circ s^n_i=\mathrm{id}_{U_n}$'), for simplicial objects of Sets; cited in the proof of Lemma 017K ('Since $s^{k-1}_i : U_{k-1} \to U_k$ is injective, see Lemma 016F')
